                                Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "be…

                                installation health — what the `claude doctor` terminal diagnostics cover —…
    /loop                       Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo).

    /claude-api                 Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params,
                                streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.…
    /advisor                    Let Claude consult a stronger model at key moments
